fields.organization: Humanitarian Coordination Office, Republic of Tamsaria
fields.title: Karun Province earthquake
fields.situation: A magnitude 6.8 earthquake struck Karun Province at 04:12 on 13 October. Aftershocks continue. The disaster management authority has declared a state of emergency in Karun North, Karun South, Bel Ravi, Soma Valley and Hadar districts. Communications are intermittent in Hadar.
fields.response: The government has requested international assistance for health, shelter and water. Eleven humanitarian organizations have reported activities in four of five affected districts. A Humanitarian Country Team meeting is held on 16 October to consider a request for cluster activation.
gaps: Hadar: no health partner has reported activity.
Soma Valley: trauma surgery capacity is below need.
Bel Ravi: no psychosocial support partner reported.
fields.access: Route 4 is open to light vehicles only north of Bel Ravi after a landslide. Hadar is reachable by Route 9 in daylight. Customs clearance for relief items takes up to 48 hours at the airport.
